user.title: Blind Control
user.description: AP2 creates a configurable, non-actuating Shadow entry. It computes inputs, decisions, traces, and snapshots without a device-write path.

data_description.window_azimuth: Direction of the configured window surface in degrees clockwise from north.
data_description.window_tilt: Tilt of the configured window surface in degrees.
data_description.axis_inverted: Use the explicitly configured inverted profile values.
data_description.automation_enabled: Disables automatic Shadow intent when switched off.
data_description.apply_enabled: Absolute gate for guarded cover execution. Keep disabled until the atomic owner handover.
data_description.runtime_mode: Shadow is non-actuating. Live only becomes writable together with the Blind Control apply-owner gate.
data_description.apply_owner: Exclusive writer ownership. Keep Legacy selected until the atomic cutover gate.
data_description.open_meteo_api_url: Validated HTTPS forecast URL for the internal read-only radiation provider. No API key, YAML, coordinates form, or restart is required.
data_description.observation_freshness_seconds: Default maximum age for time-critical owner observations.
data_description.heat_outdoor_threshold: Outdoor temperature at which thermal protection may become relevant.
data_description.heat_indoor_threshold: Indoor temperature at which thermal protection may become relevant.
data_description.heat_radiation_threshold: Minimum expected direct radiation for the heat model.
data_description.heat_confidence_threshold: Minimum solar confidence required by the heat model.
data_description.glare_confidence_threshold: Minimum solar confidence required by the glare model.
data_description.cloud_shadow_lux_drop: Observed illuminance drop used as one cloud-shadow signal.
data_description.cloud_shadow_ratio: Cloud or model ratio used for cloud-shadow evidence.
data_description.diffuse_lux_threshold: Local illuminance threshold for diffuse brightness.
data_description.night_lux_threshold: Fallback illuminance threshold when no fresh solar geometry exists.
data_description.cool_air_delta: Minimum indoor-to-outdoor temperature difference for cool air.
data_description.storm_required_signals: Number of independent weather signals required for storm evidence.
data_description.apply_cooldown_seconds: Cooldown for the Shadow apply intent; the latest target remains visible.
data_description.position_tolerance: Position difference tolerated before a new target is distinguished.

core_state_bindings.name: Core State
core_state_bindings.description: Required canonical household and activity contracts for automatic decisions.

data_description.bio_state: Required owner evidence for automatic decisions.
data_description.activity_state: Required Core-State evidence; Blind Control adapts documented state attributes for glare.
data_description.away: Required presence evidence; true means away.

opening_safety_cover_bindings.name: Opening / Safety / Cover
opening_safety_cover_bindings.description: Required Opening, cover availability/readiness and position evidence; tilted safety is conditional.

data.opening_safe_for_blind: Opening explicitly safe for the blind

data_description.opening_safe_for_blind: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.cover_available: Required HA availability or explicit availability evidence.
data_description.opening_safety_polarity: Explicitly select whether the bound signal means safe or unsafe. Unspecified polarity blocks tilted-opening safety.

solar_bindings.name: Solar
solar_bindings.description: Sun geometry and outdoor illuminance are required for daylight; trend, model radiation and clouds are optional evidence.

data_description.lux_trend: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.expected_direct_radiation: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.expected_diffuse_radiation: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.cloud_cover: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.

temperature_weather_bindings.name: Temperature / Weather
temperature_weather_bindings.description: Indoor and outdoor temperature are required; trends and weather signals are optional evidence.

data_description.indoor_temperature_trend: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_trend: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.weather_alert: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.precipitation_trend: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.wind_trend: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.pressure_trend: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.air_movement: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.

legacy_comparison_bindings.name: Legacy comparison
legacy_comparison_bindings.description: Optional old-policy evidence for field-wise Shadow diffs.

data_description.active_mode: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.effective_target: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.safety_status: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.
data_description.apply_status: Optional owner-selected evidence. Leave empty when the contract is not configured.

error.invalid_configuration: Check the position, geometry, and calibration values.
error.invalid_open_meteo_url: Use the Open-Meteo HTTPS forecast endpoint with model dwd_icon_seamless and both required current radiation fields. API keys, user information, PV parameters, and other hosts are not accepted.
